conf.description: syslog-relay, rsyslog-impstats, json (format=json): hand-built BSD-syslog header regex + Extract JSON on the counter-block body; dotted counter keys read via __e[...] bracket access, not rename; drops any record missing origin per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: syslog-relay/rsyslog-impstats/json. format="json" (NOT json-elasticsearch, which bangs the dotted keys for pre-ES-2.0 compat) emits one flat object per counter block including origin, unlike the syslog-kv sibling's legacy line. Same header regex as that sibling (own the whole parse - no pack/Elastic integration exists); JSON body Extract-JSON'd directly, still creating dotted keys (discarded.full, discarded.nf, suspended.duration, ratelimit.discarded) as flat names, read via __e[...] and deleted with a code function, per the dotted-source-key trap. Records missing origin are dropped per recommendations.direct.cribl's reject guard - here that means a malformed/legacy-shaped line. Delta-vs-previous-interval differencing needs per-key state with no verified conf shape, so NOT implemented; counters cross raw/cumulative. Zero-default for silent-loss counters IS implemented, gated on origin (core.queue/imuxsock) - README covers why syslog-kv can't do this safely.

functions.description: identify technology, dataset, format, and parsing approach; record what this format enables over the legacy sibling
split the BSD syslog header (pri, timestamp, hostname, the fixed rsyslogd-pstats tag) from the impstats JSON body

extract the flat impstats JSON object (name, origin, and the counters) into top-level fields; dotted keys (discarded.full, discarded.nf, suspended.duration, ratelimit.discarded) land as literal flat field names, not nested objects

reject any record missing origin per recommendations.direct.cribl - under format=json every valid counter block carries origin, so its absence means a malformed or legacy-shaped line reached this pipeline, not a real gap in this dataset
convert the numeric-looking counter strings (and pri) to actual numbers before they're read/renamed

read the dotted counter keys and pri with bracket access (before rename, and before they are deleted); zero-default the silent-loss counters only when origin confirms the object type they apply to; tag event.dataset

conf.code: delete __e['msg']; delete __e['pri']; delete __e['discarded.full']; delete __e['discarded.nf']; delete __e['suspended.duration']; delete __e['ratelimit.discarded'];

functions.description: drop the parsing scratch field and the raw dotted-key duplicates now that their values were copied into rsyslog.stats.* by eval; rename cannot remove these (dotted keys resolve as nested paths to rename/eval.remove)
batch-rename the header fields, origin, and every non-dotted counter (all valid flat JS identifiers) to their ECS/custom target
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
